thread:
sarah: Quick q — can we add a "preview + replay" flow in console to estimate quota/latency before a config rollout? :thinking:
ben: yes, we need it. The replay must use sampled real traffic, not synthetic. Also show cost delta estimates.
raj: Agree. Two bits: 1) preview should run in dry-run path on a subset cohort (hash-bucketing) 2) replay needs to preserve original routing decisions but swap the feature flag/route for measurement.
maria: UX: in console put a "Run preview" button that returns: expected error rate delta, p95 latency delta, token-cost estimate. show confidence interval. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ben: implementation sketch:
```
POST /internal/config/preview
{
  "config_id": "route_v2",
  "cohort_pct": 5,
  "replay_window_hours": 2
}
```
raj: Also need to ensure privacy: scrub user identifiers in replay payloads and honor PII opt-outs.
sarah: Good point. Ops: how to avoid extra load on backends during replay? we can't double traffic for production.
ops-bot: runbook suggestion: use asynchronous sampled mirror + rate-limit to backend, fallback mode = "no-backend" if saturation > 0.6
maria: We should add a "dry-cost" knob that estimates token/machine cost using stored perf profiles rather than hitting real infra.
ben: metric contract: preview must emit 'preview_event' with tags: config_id, cohort, p95_delta, error_delta, cost_estimate. This goes to preview-dashboard stream.
raj: For rollout automation, tie preview_results to safe-rollout predicate: pass only if p95_delta < 10ms and error_delta < 0.1% and cost_estimate < 5%.
sarah: ok. I'll mock a console PR for the button + small backend API. Can someone own the privacy mask & replay infra? @raj? :eyes:
raj: I'll take ownership. will draft infra plan today.
maria: i'll design dashboard mockups and show the CI style pass/fail badge. 
ben: I'll add the telemetry contract and a lightweight replay runner.
sarah: awesome. If anyone sees regulatory red flags (EU customers) call out now.
raj: noted, will add region-exclude flag.
maria: +1 from me. moving to #design for mockups after lunch. :rocket:
